quote.citation: 1995, HAL Laboratory, EarthBound, Nintendo, Super Nintendo Entertainment System:
quote.text: Bye bye! Let's play again some time!

definitions.definition: (colloquial, childish) Bedtime for a toddler, going to sleep, going to bed.

quote.citation: 1885, Richard F. Burton, chapter XXII, in The Book of the Thousand Nights and a Night, volume I, The Burton Club, page 224:
quote.text: "[H]e came to the gate of the city; and finding it shut lay him down and went to by-by!"
